title: Kirkland Advises Braemont Capital and JettyCove Holdings on Investment in RedTeam Software | News | Kirkland & Ellis LLP
markdown:
[![Kirkland & Ellis LLP](https://www.kirkland.com/assets/public/images/logo.svg)](https://www.kirkland.com/)

Top

Kirkland & Ellis advised Texas investment firms Braemont Capital and JettyCove Holdings on their investments in RedTeam Software, a construction management software provider, and in connection with RedTeam’s acquisition of PASKR, a cloud-based construction management solution. Financial terms were not disclosed.

The Braemont team was led by corporate partner Thomas Laughlin and associate Tori Newton, with support from corporate associate Ben Sharp, litigation partner Olivia Adendorff, tax partners David Wheat, Steve Butler and Lane Morgan, investment funds partners Matt Nadworny and Erica Rozow and associate Randy Coffey, technology & IP transactions partner Matt Lovell, executive compensation partners Stephen Jacobson and Jake Ebers and associate Michael Thompson, employee benefits partner Alexandra Mihalas and labor and employment partner R.D. Kohut and associates Alexis Grinstead and Anusheh Khoshsima.

The JettyCove team was led by corporate partner John Kaercher and associates Anika Khan and Oscar Leija, with support from tax partner Jon Nelsen and associate Courtney Loyack, investment funds partner Ian Jelsma and associate August Jones-Loiacono and technology & IP transactions partner Aaron Lorber and associate Jessie Perlman.
